title: site.register, contract version 1
description: Registers a site (PRD 5.8, 5.9, 11.14) in one changeset: its root node, a node of kind site at the top of the tree, the site with its handle, the locales it publishes in, and in each locale the route / to the root node. Sites are configuration in git, so the kernel runs the command itself: cms:sites:sync registers each configured site the database lacks as the installation operator, and no surface exposes it. A locale named twice is validation_failed; a site with the id or the handle, read or committed meanwhile, is version_conflict. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Structure\Domain\Commands\RegisterSite, and the generated codec RegisterSiteCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

site.description: The new site's id, which the caller makes.

handle.description: The site's handle, as cbox-cms.sites names it: a lower-case letter followed by at most 62 lower-case letters, digits or underscores.

root.description: The id of the site's root node, which the caller makes.

locales.description: The locales the site publishes in, at least one, each once.

locale.description: A language tag of a language, an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS; the kernel writes the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.
